newsitem.title: USA: ATLHETICS-TANUI, PIPPIG TO DEFEND BOSTON MARATHON CROWNS.
newsitem.headline: ATLHETICS-TANUI, PIPPIG TO DEFEND BOSTON MARATHON CROWNS.

text.p: Moses Tanui of Kenya and Uta Pippig of Germany will defend their titles in the 101st running of the Boston Marathon on April 21, event sponsors announced Friday.
Tanui, winner of the historic 100th Boston Marathon last year, will again go head-to-head with compatriot and three-time Boston winner Cosmas Ndeti in the elite men's field.
Tanui and Ndeti, who broke the course record with his 1994 victory, will also be challenged by Mexico's German Silva, a two-time winner of the New York City Marathon making his Boston debut.

Pippig, who will be running for her fourth victory in the world's oldest annual marathon, will defend in a women's field that includes Olympic champion Fatuma Roba of Ethiopia, who will be running the prestigious Boston race for the first time.
